source_ref.quote: SIDEWALK CLOSED signs (see Figure 6G-1) should be used where pedestrian flow is restricted.
Bicyclist/ Pedestrian Detour (M4-9a) signs or Pedestrian Detour (M4-9b) signs should be used where pedestrian flow is rerouted (see Section 6I.02).
The SIDEWALK CLOSED (R9-9) sign should be installed at the beginning of the closed sidewalk, at the intersections preceding the closed sidewalk, and elsewhere along the closed sidewalk as needed.
The SIDEWALK CLOSED, (ARROW) USE OTHER SIDE (R9-10) sign should be installed at the beginning of the restricted sidewalk when a parallel sidewalk exists on the other side of the roadway.

The SIDEWALK CLOSED AHEAD, (ARROW) CROSS HERE (R9-11) sign should be used to indicate to pedestrians that sidewalks beyond the sign are closed and to direct them to open crosswalks, sidewalks, or other travel paths.
The SIDEWALK CLOSED, (ARROW) CROSS HERE (R9-11a) sign should be installed just beyond the point to which pedestrians are being redirected.
These signs are typically mounted on a detectable barricade to encourage compliance and to communicate with pedestrians that the sidewalk is closed.
Each detour shall be adequately marked with standard temporary route signs and destination signs.

The DETOUR (M4-9) sign (see Figure 6I-1) should be used for unnumbered highways, for emergency situations, for periods of short durations, or where, over relatively short distances, road users are guided along the detour and back to the desired highway without route signs.
A Street Name sign should be placed above, or the street name should be incorporated into, a DETOUR (M4-9) sign to indicate the name of the street being detoured.
The END DETOUR (M4-8a) sign or the END (M4-8bP) plaque (see Figure 6I-1) may be used to indicate that the detour has ended.
When the END DETOUR sign is used on a numbered highway, the sign should be mounted above a route sign after the downstream end of the detour.

The Pedestrian/Bicyclist Detour (M4-9a) sign (see Figure 6I-1) should be used where a pedestrian/bicyclist detour route has been established because of the closing of a pedestrian/bicycle facility to through traffic.
If used, the Pedestrian/Bicyclist Detour sign shall have an arrow pointing in the appropriate direction.
The arrow on a Pedestrian/Bicyclist Detour sign may be on the sign face or on a supplemental plaque.

The Pedestrian Detour (M4-9b) sign or Bicyclist Detour (M4-9c) sign (see Figure 6I-1) may be used where a pedestrian or a bicyclist detour route (not both) has been established because of the closing of the pedestrian or bicycle facility to through traffic.

rule.text: Optional per zone: applies only when the SME switches on the sidewalk-closed add-on (addon_sidewalk_closed; S11 ADDON:sidewalk_closed). Use SIDEWALK CLOSED signs where pedestrian flow is restricted.

Optional per zone: applies only when the SME switches on the sidewalk-closed add-on (addon_sidewalk_closed; S11 ADDON:sidewalk_closed). Where pedestrian flow is rerouted, use M4-9a or M4-9b detour signs (Sect. 6I.02).

Optional per zone: applies only when the SME switches on the sidewalk-closed add-on (addon_sidewalk_closed; S11 ADDON:sidewalk_closed). R9-9 at the beginning of the closed sidewalk, at the intersections before it, and along it as needed.

Optional per zone: applies only when the SME switches on the sidewalk-closed add-on (addon_sidewalk_closed; S11 ADDON:sidewalk_closed). R9-10 at the beginning of the restricted sidewalk when a parallel sidewalk exists on the other side.

Optional per zone: applies only when the SME switches on the sidewalk-closed add-on (addon_sidewalk_closed; S11 ADDON:sidewalk_closed). R9-11 tells pedestrians the sidewalk ahead is closed and directs them to an open crosswalk, sidewalk or path.

Optional per zone: applies only when the SME switches on the sidewalk-closed add-on (addon_sidewalk_closed; S11 ADDON:sidewalk_closed). R9-11a just beyond the point to which pedestrians are redirected.
Optional per zone: applies only when the SME switches on the sidewalk-closed add-on (addon_sidewalk_closed; S11 ADDON:sidewalk_closed). These signs are typically mounted on a detectable barricade.
Optional per zone. Each detour shall be adequately marked with standard temporary route signs and destination signs.
Optional per zone. M4-9 for unnumbered highways, emergencies, short durations, or short detours guided without route signs.
Optional per zone. Put a Street Name sign above the M4-9, or the street name in it.
Optional per zone. END DETOUR (M4-8a) may mark the end of the detour (the M4-8bP alternative is not loaded).
Optional per zone. On a numbered highway, END DETOUR above a route sign after the downstream end of the detour.
Optional per zone. M4-9a where a pedestrian/bicyclist detour route is established because a facility is closed.
Optional per zone. If used, the Pedestrian/Bicyclist Detour sign shall have an arrow pointing the right way.
Optional per zone. The arrow may be on the sign face or on a supplemental plaque.
Optional per zone. M4-9b (pedestrian) or M4-9c (bicyclist) may be used where a detour for one of them (not both) is established.
